Paper Name: Assessing the 3E performance of multiple energy supply scenarios based on photovoltaic, wind turbine, battery and hydrogen systems
NOTES: This paper investigates 3 energy supply scenarios (ESS1: PV+WT direct+grid, ESS2: PV+WT+battery, ESS3: PV+WT+hydrogen). Values extracted are the total system configuration (same PV+WT for all scenarios). Annual load demand calculated from PV+WT generation (34670.93 kWh/yr) minus surplus (20935.10 kWh/yr) divided by ECR1 (52.56%) = 26133.62 kWh/yr. PV capacity is 13.2 kWp total. WT rated power is 7.5 kW. Battery capacity is 45 kWh (Li-ion). Hydrogen storage capacity is 2.7 kg. Electrolyzer rated capacity is 14 kW (PEM, 70% efficiency). Fuel cell rated capacity is 14 kW (PEM, 40% efficiency). LCOE values: ESS1=0.05, ESS2=0.09, ESS3=0.21 $/kWh. SPP values: ESS1=5.80, ESS2=7.89, ESS3=16.30 years. LPSP not explicitly reported but ESS2 and ESS3 achieve 100% ECR (zero loss of power supply). N_PV=24 panels (12 series x 2 parallel). Inverter nominal power=10kW, max efficiency=97.8%. PV panel max efficiency=21.32%. No wind turbines count specified (single WT assumed). Diesel generator not considered in this study. Hydrogen tank cost is 378 $/kgH2. OPEX is 2% of CAPEX. Discount rate d=3%. Electricity price=0.116 $/kWh. Inverter included in PV system cost.
LPSP: 100% coverage for ESS2 and ESS3 (47.44% unmet for ESS1, met by grid)
